text: To ensure development approvals related to 1996 – 2000 Bathurst Street, an application which has already been approved by City Council on March 9, 2017 but is now awaiting Zoning Bylaw approval. This matter is urgent because of the City Council recess period.
City Council on July 23, 24, 25, 26, 27 and 30, 2018 received Item TE34.208 for information.
